subject: Re: Scheduling: Multi-region product demo (US / EU / APAC) — exec availability
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Connor <sarah.connor@acme.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@globex.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Scheduling: Multi-region product demo (US / EU / APAC) — exec availability

Hi Sarah / Tom -

Thanks again for the quick intro call. We're excited to get a tailored demo in front of your execs and the regional teams. Because the decision group spans US, EU, and APAC, I wanted to surface a few constraints and propose windows that work for our execs.

Quick notes:
- Vivek (our CEO) prefers mornings PT (08:00-11:00 PT).
- EU stakeholders (CET/CEST) generally prefer late afternoons (15:00-18:00 CET).
- APAC (AEST / IST) has tight mornings and early evenings — typically 09:00-11:00 AEST or 17:00-19:00 IST.
- Daylight savings: note that US switches DST in mid-March; if you're planning dates in late March onward, local offsets will change — happy to reconfirm then.

Proposed 60-min demo windows (all listed with local equivalents):
A) 10:00 PT / 18:00 CET / 02:00 AEST (next day) — good for EU + US but late for APAC
B) 08:30 PT / 16:30 CET / 00:30 AEST (next day) — earlier for US execs, still late for APAC
C) 07:00 PT / 15:00 CET / 23:00 AEST (same day) — better APAC overlap but very early US
D) 16:00 CET / 08:00 PT / 00:00 AEST (next day) — alternative ordering depending on which side we prioritize

We've attached a CSV with granular proposed slots and asked exec_availability.ics to capture tentative availability. Can you share the preferred window(s) for your executive and regional attendees and any absolute no-go times? If it helps, we can propose two options and lock a canary session with a smaller working group before full exec slot.

Thanks — I'll coordinate logistics and calendar invites once we have a preference.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: proposed_times.csv (proposed slots), exec_availability.ics (exec calendars stub)

Subject: Re: Scheduling: Multi-region product demo (US / EU / APAC) — exec availability

Hi Marissa / Jonas -

Really appreciate the options and the daylight-savings heads-up. For ACME:
- Our CEO (Sarah) is available 16:00-18:00 CET most weekdays.
- Our APAC lead (Tom) is flexible but prefers not to be on calls past 20:30 IST.
- We have a board review the week of Mar 22, so earlier in March is preferable for a final exec session.

Quick preference: Option A (10:00 PT / 18:00 CET) works best for our execs if Vivek can do 10:00 PT. Otherwise, Option C with a canary session for the APAC stakeholders is OK.

I've attached a short note with our confirmed attendees and time constraints.

Sarah

Sarah / Marissa -

Thanks for the quick reply. I spoke with Vivek: he can make 10:00 PT on weekdays the week of Mar 8 or Mar 15, but not the week of Mar 22 (conflicts with board prep).

Given ACME's preference for Option A, proposed next steps:
1) Tentatively hold 10:00 PT / 18:00 CET on Tue, Mar 9 (60 min) as the exec session.
2) Schedule a canary/demo rehearsal for the APAC & engineering stakeholders on Mon, Mar 8 at 07:00 PT / 15:00 CET / 23:00 AEST (45 min) to validate live data connectors and SSO flow.
3) Laura, can you own the invites and make sure we include the recording + runbook?

Also note: Mar 9 is before US DST start, so current offsets apply; if we end up moving to late March, we'll need to re-evaluate local times.

Jonas
